description: A garrison operations officer must publish tomorrow's installation access and staging plan for three routine support work parties, setting their entry points, access windows, escort requirements, and staging locations while coordinating with security, facilities, and the motor pool.

shared_context.S1: Tomorrow's routine support schedule includes a communications-calibration team, a water-treatment contractor, and a generator-inspection vehicle.
shared_context.S2: The installation has East Gate and North Gate for routine vehicle entry, with staging pads A, B, and C available inside the perimeter.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez publishes the binding access and staging plan before the next day's first scheduled work party.
shared_context.S4: The installation holds a daily access-coordination meeting before the plan is published, and security, facilities, and motor-pool representatives report any changes affecting their work parties.

PF1.text: The communications-calibration team's temporary badges are valid only from 0830 to 0930 tomorrow and can be activated only at East Gate; Lt. Morgan received the confirmed badge roster from the visitor-control desk this morning, but the roster has not yet been added to the access brief.

PF2.text: The water-treatment contractor cannot enter the plant until the scheduled electrical lockout is released at exactly 1130 tomorrow, after which the contractor needs the reserved work period; SFC Patel confirmed the release time with the utilities supervisor today, but the facilities schedule still shows the ordinary morning access window.

PF3.text: The generator-inspection vehicle is 38 feet long, and the motor-pool check confirms that North Gate's turning radius cannot accommodate it; it must use East Gate and stage at Pad C, but WO1 Brooks has not yet posted the vehicle-dimension update to the movement board.

acceptance_conditions: The communications-calibration team must enter through East Gate during the 0830-0930 badge-validity window.
The communications-calibration team must have an escort requirement recorded.
The water-treatment contractor must be scheduled to enter at exactly 1130.
The generator-inspection vehicle must use East Gate and stage at Pad C.
The plan must include a visitor-control confirmation, a utilities lockout-release confirmation, and a motor-pool traffic-control commitment.
The confirmed communications badge restriction must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'visitor_control_confirmation' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'utilities_lockout_release' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'motor_pool_traffic_control' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The temporary badge restriction changes the communications team's gate to East Gate, fixes its access window at 0830-0930, and requires an escort to be recorded.
The exact 1130 lockout-release time changes the water contractor's entry from the ordinary morning window to 1130.
The 38-foot vehicle dimension changes the generator vehicle's gate to East Gate and its staging location to Pad C.
